description:
U by Urbeo is proud to present U Hansfield, a residential development superbly located beside Hansfield Train Station.

Key features:

- Prime location: 2-minute walk to Hansfield Train Station (25 mins to Docklands & Connolly)
- Excellent transport links: Dublin Bus 39 & 39a (direct to City Centre & UCD)
- Easy access to M3 & M50 motorways
- A-rated, energy-efficient apartments
- Spacious, modern layouts with generous storage
- Stylish interiors by Ventura Living with bespoke U furniture
- Fully fitted kitchens with integrated appliances & separate utility room
- Bright living areas with private balconies
- Residents’ lounge & multi-function room
- On-site Centra, Grafton Barbers, OOHPod parcel lockers & crèche

Location Highlights:

- Close to Blanchardstown, Leixlip & Clonee employment hubs
- Minutes from Blanchardstown Shopping Centre
- Super Value just 5-mins walk, also close by to Dunnes Stores, Lidl & Tesco
- Close to Phoenix Park & Castleknock Golf Club
- Excellent selection of schools & childcare facilities nearby

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
